subject.title: feat(cli): `skills uninstall` design proposal + prior art reconciliation

question: Should OpenClaw add a destructive `openclaw skills uninstall <slug>` command for ClawHub-tracked workspace/global skills, and what should it do for manual or non-ClawHub skill directories?
rationale: The missing command is real, but deletion behavior and non-ClawHub handling are product/security choices that should not be inferred by automation after several unmerged attempts chose different surfaces.

options.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
options.body: Land a focused CLI/lifecycle implementation that removes the safe-resolved ClawHub skill directory and lockfile entry, with prompt, dry-run, JSON, and explicit manual-skill behavior.

options.title: Gateway-first lifecycle
options.body: Defer the CLI command until maintainers define a shared Gateway or lifecycle API that both CLI and dashboard surfaces can reuse.

options.title: Do not add core uninstall yet
options.body: Keep manual removal and docs as the supported path until ClawHub skill lifecycle ownership is redesigned more broadly.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
recommendation.body: Land a focused CLI/lifecycle implementation that removes the safe-resolved ClawHub skill directory and lockfile entry, with prompt, dry-run, JSON, and explicit manual-skill behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The native ClawHub install/update code and current skills lifecycle ownership history point here for the product-boundary decision.
